test_cases.description: guardSlug should correctly prepend '/' to multi-segment paths without a leading slash, verifying the function works for arbitrary path strings not just single-segment slugs
test_cases.input_description: A multi-segment path like 'foo/bar/baz' without leading slash

test_cases.description: guardSlug should preserve trailing slashes and not strip or alter any part of the slug beyond ensuring the leading slash
test_cases.input_description: A slug with trailing slash like '/cartographer/'

test_cases.description: guardSlug should handle single non-slash characters by prepending '/', detecting implementations that only handle known route slugs
guardSlug should return input unchanged when it already starts with '/' even if it has double slashes internally, since the contract only guarantees leading slash normalization
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns '//double' unchanged since it already starts with '/'

test_cases.description: guardSlug should return a string primitive, not an object wrapper, ensuring the return type is usable directly in navigation
Each node in PIPELINE_NODES should have the correct slug corresponding to its stepId, ensuring the mapping is not shuffled or hardcoded incorrectly
Each node should have the correct human-readable label matching the StepLabel enum, not just any string
All slugs in PIPELINE_NODES should be unique — no two nodes should share the same route slug
All x and y coordinates in PIPELINE_NODES must be actual numbers, not strings or NaN, to ensure SVG rendering correctness
PIPELINE_EDGES should contain exactly the 14 specified edges with correct from/to pairs, not just 14 arbitrary edges
PIPELINE_EDGES should not contain any edges beyond the specified 14 — no spurious connections like reversed edges or shortcuts
The root node (cartographer) should have exactly 2 outgoing edges — to constrain and ledger — verifying the branching structure
The baton node should have exactly 3 outgoing edges — to sentinel, chronicler, and stigmergy — verifying the triple-branch
The apprentice node should have exactly 3 incoming edges — from sentinel, chronicler, and stigmergy — verifying the merge point
The arbiter node should have exactly 2 incoming edges — from pact and advocate — verifying the first merge point
PipelineDiagram should render the exact number of node groups matching a custom subset of nodes passed via props, not always 12
test_cases.input_description: A custom nodes array with only 3 nodes and corresponding edges
assertions: Renders exactly 3 elements with role='link' when given 3 custom nodes
Each of the 3 custom node labels appears in the rendered output

test_cases.description: PipelineDiagram should render the exact number of edge elements matching a custom edges array, not always 14
test_cases.input_description: A custom nodes array with 3 nodes and 2 edges
assertions: Renders exactly 2 line or path elements for edges when given 2 custom edges

test_cases.description: Each clickable node group should contain both a rect element and a text element, forming a proper labeled box
assertions: Every element with role='link' contains a rect child element
Every element with role='link' contains a text child element

test_cases.description: Every node group must have tabIndex=0 for keyboard focusability, not just some nodes
assertions: All elements with role='link' have tabIndex 0

test_cases.description: Pressing keys other than Enter and Space on a node should NOT trigger navigation, ensuring only the specified keys activate the handler
test_cases.input_description: Fire keydown event with key 'Tab' or 'a' on a node group
assertions: onNodeClick is not called when pressing Tab key
onNodeClick is not called when pressing 'a' key

test_cases.description: The module should not have a default export, ensuring implementations use named exports only as specified by the contract
When className prop is not provided, the SVG root should not have an undefined or 'undefined' class attribute
assertions: SVG root element does not have class='undefined' or class containing 'undefined'

test_cases.description: Clicking each individual node in the default diagram should invoke onNodeClick with the correct slug for that specific node, catching implementations that return the same slug for all nodes
assertions: Clicking the cartographer node calls onNodeClick with '/cartographer'
Clicking the kindex node calls onNodeClick with '/kindex'
Clicking the stigmergy node calls onNodeClick with '/stigmergy'

test_cases.description: guardSlug should handle a whitespace-only input by treating it as a non-empty string and prepending '/', since the contract only specifies error for empty string
PIPELINE_NODES must be an actual array instance, not an array-like object, ensuring standard array methods work
PIPELINE_EDGES must be an actual array instance, not an array-like object
Every edge object in PIPELINE_EDGES must have both 'from' and 'to' string properties, not null/undefined
When a custom node has a slug without leading slash, PipelineDiagram must still apply the slug guard and call onNodeClick with the corrected slug
test_cases.input_description: Custom node with slug 'noSlash' (no leading slash)
assertions: Clicking node with slug 'noSlash' calls onNodeClick with '/noSlash'
